enchantments.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Shrieking: Shrieking weapons emit a piercing screech whenever they are used to make a successful attack. This screech deals an additional 2 to 12 sonic damage.
Cacophony: This weapon stores the power of a hundred blasts of sound within. Occasionally, this resonating power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with massive sonic damage.
Weapon Focus: Falchion: While equipped this item gives you the feat Weapon Focus: Slashing but only for Falchions, giving a +1 to your attack bonus while using Falchions.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
